is.description: \* \`scheduled\` - Sending the e-invoice to the customer has been scheduled. \* \`skipped\` - The e-invoice was not sent. This could be due to missing information or because the `entity_identifier` is not registered on the e-invoicing network. \* \`in_progress\` - The e-invoice has been sent and Chargebee is waiting for confirmation from the receiving entity. \* \`success\` - The e-invoice has been successfully delivered to the customer. \* \`failed\` - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered. \* \`registered\` - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered but got cleared in the IRP.

is_not.description: \* \`scheduled\` - Sending the e-invoice to the customer has been scheduled. \* \`skipped\` - The e-invoice was not sent. This could be due to missing information or because the `entity_identifier` is not registered on the e-invoicing network. \* \`in_progress\` - The e-invoice has been sent and Chargebee is waiting for confirmation from the receiving entity. \* \`success\` - The e-invoice has been successfully delivered to the customer. \* \`failed\` - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered. \* \`registered\` - The e-invoice was sent and there was an error due to which it was not delivered but got cleared in the IRP.
